evaluators.name: DeciderGroundedness
evaluators.description: Strands Decider checks that every fact in the agent response is supported by tool results.

question.instructions: The conversation shows an HR assistant turn. Tool calls and their results are listed between User and Assistant messages. Is every factual claim in the final Assistant message (PTO balances, dates, policy terms, benefit amounts, pay figures, request IDs) supported by the tool results shown, or by earlier conversation turns? General courtesy, clarifying questions, and statements that information is unavailable are not factual claims.

evaluators.name: DeciderHelpfulness
evaluators.description: Strands Decider rates how far the agent response moves the employee toward their goal.

question.instructions: The conversation shows one turn of an HR assistant session. Rate how much the final Assistant message moves the employee toward the goal expressed in the User message. Judge from the employee's point of view.
criteria: Not helpful: ignores the request, obstructs it, or leads the employee in the wrong direction.
Slightly helpful: related to the request but leaves the employee mostly where they started.
Helpful: answers the request or completes the requested action.
Very helpful: answers completely and anticipates the obvious next step without padding.

evaluators.name: DeciderGoalCompletion
evaluators.description: Strands Decider decides whether the employee's goals were achieved across the whole session.

question.instructions: The conversation shows a complete HR assistant session. Considering every goal the employee expressed across all turns, did the assistant achieve them by the end of the session? A goal counts as achieved only when the employee received a correct answer grounded in tool results, or the requested action was completed.

criteria.achieved: Every goal the employee expressed was achieved.
criteria.partially_achieved: At least one goal was achieved and at least one was not.
criteria.not_achieved: No goal the employee expressed was achieved.
